His head moves with subtle natural conversational emphasis, eyes blinking at a normal relaxed rate, mouth partially open with only the front teeth partially visible, lips moving naturally. The ambient sound of an open urban rooftop at dusk — faint city traffic below, light wind — runs underneath his relaxed, unhurried delivery.
